# basic-xray fixture

This fixture uses disposable test-only REALITY keys.

The private key is intentionally committed for deterministic interop testing.
Never reuse this key in production.

Captured `client_hello.bin` was generated by Xray REALITY client (client version
`1.8.0.0` in `expected_client_version.txt`).

The integration test passes `min_client_ver: None` so this legacy capture still
passes pre-auth checks; production configs apply the Xray-core default
`minClientVer` (`26.3.27`) when the field is omitted or empty.

The fixture validates REALITY pre-auth compatibility:

- X25519 key share extraction
- HKDF auth key derivation
- AES-256-GCM `session_id` decrypt
- shortId / SNI / client version / unix time extraction
